title: jmap-server: per-call access hook so federation peer-role check covers all handlers
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 L260: a peer caller MUST receive forbidden for any non-Peer/* method. JMAP-v9py.15.3 added jmap_chat_federation_server::check_method_access, but jmap_server::Dispatcher has no pre-handler hook, so handlers registered by register_chat_handlers (and the other register_* fns) never run it and a deployment cannot insert it per method call (dropping/rewriting calls breaks result references and response ordering). Needs a decision (foundation API change): options (a) additive Dispatcher method guard, e.g. Dispatcher::set_guard(Arc<dyn Fn(&str, &CallerCtx) -> Result<(), JmapError> + Send + Sync>) run before handler lookup; (b) leave to deployments that run their own dispatch loop. Recommendation: (a).
